violations.description: Hardcoded API secret token exposed in source code
violations.recommendation: Remove credential immediately and read from environment variables or a secrets manager.

violations.description: Dangerous pull_request_target trigger checking out pull request head
violations.evidence: Workflow uses pull_request_target trigger combined with actions/checkout for ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
violations.recommendation: Use pull_request trigger instead or avoid checking out untrusted PR head code.

violations.evidence: Top-level permissions configured with permissions: write-all
violations.recommendation: Follow the principle of least privilege by specifying read-all or explicit fine-grained permissions per job.
Replace machine-specific absolute path with relative paths or environment configuration.

violations.description: Missing dependency lockfile for reproducible builds
violations.evidence: Pipfile exists in repository root but Pipfile.lock is absent
violations.recommendation: Generate and commit Pipfile.lock to guarantee deterministic dependency resolution.

violations.description: Automated tests not executed in CI pull request pipeline
violations.evidence: PR workflow only runs linting without any pytest or unit test step
violations.recommendation: Add an automated test execution step in the CI pipeline before merging.
